loginFieldMasked.description: The login field is masked in every screenshot this capture points at. A capture that cannot say so is EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE, never an unmasked picture.

captureStartedAfterRedirect.description: Capture began after the sign-in redirect landed. Everything before that moment can hold a credential on screen, so a capture that cannot say this is evidence that may never be published.

control.description: The rendered surface control this step pressed to produce what was observed, identified the way a rendered node is identified elsewhere in this tree (capture.schema.json nodes[].path): a path into the rendered tree. A walk is evidence only for what it pressed, so an assertion produced by any other means — an endpoint, a mutation, a console command called from page context — names no control here and cannot carry this field.

stepId.description: Under driver mode playwright: the expect step of the walk that produced this assertion; the validator requires control to equal that step's target as the walk states it.

driver.description: Present when the capture was produced by scripts/browser-walk.mjs from a declarative walk (@tools/browsercontrol mode playwright): the walk it ran and the result the runner wrote beside it. A capture that carries this and no walk or result on disk is refused, and every assertion's control is checked against the walk step it names.
